segment_contamination_dimensions: Folding/foldable motorised garage segment carved out by sibling MCAT 'Folding Garage' (ID: 107235) — enhanced names and alt names must not exclusively target the folding/motorised-fold sub-segment; terms like 'folding garage' are retained in alt_names as buyer search vocabulary but no enhanced name variant is built around folding as the primary differentiator

Industrial/warehouse shed segment (siblings: Industrial Sheds, Warehouse Sheds, Prefabricated Factory Shed, PEB Structures Fabrication) — buyer persona is large-scale industrial operator vs residential/small-commercial vehicle owner; names implying factory, warehouse, or large-span industrial shed are excluded

Toy/miniature garage and unrelated items (garage oven, diorama garage) — observed in keyword contamination signals; no enhanced name or alt name entry targets toy, miniature, simulation, or diorama contexts

Multi-storey or permanent prefab parking garage segment — 'prefab parking garage' can attract permanent structure enquiries belonging to a different MCAT; enhanced names are anchored to portable/relocatable/canopy/kit framing to avoid this contamination
